requirements.title: Construction, host resolution and credential isolation
requirements.rationale: One OLLAMA_HOST value must mean the same server for the ollama CLI and AgentKit, and no credential may leave the process.

criteria.condition: ollama.New is called with a core.Model whose trimmed ID is non-empty and a valid host
criteria.action: return a *Client that implements core.ProviderClient, make no network request, and expose the resolved base URL through (*Client).Host(); the exported constant ollama.API equals core.APIOllamaChat
criteria.contract: (*Client, nil); the recording server sees zero requests after New returns; Host() returns e.g. "http://127.0.0.1:11434"

setup: an httptest recording server counting requests
a core.Model with ID "qwen3.8:27b"
check.pseudocode: c, err := ollama.New(m, opts); var _ core.ProviderClient = c; assert err == nil; assert c.Host() == srv.URL; assert srv.count == 0; assert ollama.API == core.APIOllamaChat

criteria.condition: ollama.New is called with a core.Model whose ID is empty after trimming whitespace
criteria.action: refuse to build the client
criteria.contract: (nil, non-nil error) whose text starts with "ollama:"

setup: a core.Model whose ID is "" and another whose ID is "   \t"
check.pseudocode: for id in ['', '   \t']: c, err := New(Model{ID:id}, Options{}); assert c == nil; assert err != nil; assert hasPrefix(err.Error(), 'ollama:')

criteria.action: take the host from Options.Host when it is set and read no variable at all; otherwise look up OLLAMA_HOST in Options.Env first (an empty value falls through), then through Options.Getenv when it is non-nil, otherwise from the process environment, using http://127.0.0.1:11434 (ollama.DefaultHost) when the value is empty or unset, and never read any variable other than OLLAMA_HOST
criteria.contract: a Getenv spy records only the key "OLLAMA_HOST", and records nothing when Options.Host is set

setup: a Getenv spy that records every key asked
t.Setenv sets OLLAMA_HOST in the process environment for one case
check.pseudocode: New(m, {Host:'h1', Getenv:spy}); assert spy.keys == []; New(m, {Env:{OLLAMA_HOST:''}, Getenv:spy}); assert spy.keys == ['OLLAMA_HOST']; assert Host()==DefaultHost when all empty

criteria.action: for any trimmed host value, resolve the base URL by Ollama's CLI rules: no scheme means http with port 11434, http:// without a port means port 80, https:// without a port means port 443, and a path is kept
criteria.contract: Host() returns e.g. "http://example.local:11434" for "example.local", "https://h:443" for "https://h", "http://h:80/proxy" for "http://h/proxy"

setup: hosts generated from scheme (none, http, https), hostname, optional port, optional path, optional surrounding whitespace
no network
check.pseudocode:
for h in gen_hosts(): c = New(m,{Host:h}); u = parse(c.Host()); assert u.scheme == expectScheme(h); assert u.port == expectPort(h); assert u.path == pathOf(h)
table-driven assert New(m,{Host:in}).Host() == want

criteria.condition: the host value has a scheme other than http or https, cannot be parsed, or carries a port outside 1-65535
criteria.action: refuse to build the client
criteria.contract: (nil, error) with errors.Is(err, ollama.ErrInvalidHost) true and text starting with "ollama:"

check.pseudocode: for h in bad: c, err := New(m,{Host:h}); assert c==nil; assert errors.Is(err, ErrInvalidHost); assert hasPrefix(err.Error(),'ollama:')

criteria.condition: the host value carries user information
criteria.action: refuse to build the client and show the host with any password redacted
criteria.contract: (nil, error) wrapping ollama.ErrInvalidHost; the error text does not contain the password

setup: host "http://user:s3cretpw@h:11434" and "http://user@h"
check.pseudocode: c, err := New(m,{Host:'http://user:s3cretpw@h'}); assert errors.Is(err, ErrInvalidHost); assert !contains(err.Error(),'s3cretpw')

criteria.condition: the host is ollama.com or any subdomain of ollama.com
criteria.action: refuse to build the client and say the hosted Ollama service is not supported
criteria.contract: (nil, error) wrapping ollama.ErrInvalidHost whose text says the hosted service is not supported

setup: hosts "ollama.com", "https://ollama.com", "https://api.ollama.com:443", and "notollama.com" as a control
check.pseudocode: for h in hosted: assert errors.Is(err, ErrInvalidHost) && contains(err.Error(),'not supported'); assert New(m,{Host:'notollama.com'}) ok

criteria.action: send every request through a transport layer that deletes any Authorization header before handing the request to Options.HTTPClient's transport (or the default transport when HTTPClient is nil), so no credential is sent even when ANTHROPIC_API_KEY, OPENROUTER_API_KEY or OLLAMA_API_KEY are set, while an embedder's own transport beneath the layer may still add headers
criteria.contract: the recording server sees no Authorization header and no other provider's variable value anywhere in any request; a header set by the embedder's RoundTripper reaches the server

setup: ANTHROPIC_API_KEY, OPENROUTER_API_KEY and OLLAMA_API_KEY set via t.Setenv to distinctive values
an HTTPClient whose RoundTripper adds X-Embedder: yes and also Authorization: Bearer x before delegating
a recording httptest server
check.pseudocode: drain(c.Stream(ctx, req)); for r in srv.requests: assert r.Header.Get('Authorization')==''; assert r.Header['X-Embedder']==['yes']; assert !containsAny(r.raw, secrets)

requirements.title: Request encoding
requirements.rationale: The window the agent prunes against must be the one the model loads at, and Request fields must mean the same thing on every provider.

criteria.condition: Stream is called with a live context
criteria.action: send exactly one chat request through the SDK client's Chat method to the resolved host's /api/chat with stream true, model equal to m.ID exactly as written, truncate false, and options.num_ctx equal to m.ContextWindow
criteria.contract: the recorded body carries "model", "stream":true, "truncate":false and "options":{"num_ctx":<window>,...}

setup: a recording server
a model with ID "Qwen3.8:27B-Odd" and ContextWindow 16384
check.pseudocode: r = srv.only(); assert r.path=='/api/chat'; b=json(r.body); assert b.model==m.ID && b.stream==true && b.truncate==false && b.options.num_ctx==16384

criteria.condition: Stream is called and m.ContextWindow is zero or negative
criteria.action: send options.num_ctx equal to catalog.OllamaDefaultContextWindow
criteria.contract: the recorded body carries "num_ctx":32768

setup: models with ContextWindow 0 and -5
catalog.OllamaDefaultContextWindow is 32768
check.pseudocode: for w in [0,-5]: body = record(Model{ContextWindow:w}); assert body.options.num_ctx == catalog.OllamaDefaultContextWindow

criteria.action: order the request messages as one system message whose content is the text blocks of Request.System joined by a blank line (omitted when that text is empty), then Request.Prefix, then the repaired Request.Messages
criteria.contract: recorded messages[0] has role "system" only when Request.System has text

setup: Request.System with two text blocks "A" and "B"
a one-message Prefix and a one-message transcript
a second request with no System text
check.pseudocode: assert roles(b1.messages)==['system','user','user']; assert b1.messages[0].content=='A\n\nB'; assert 'system' not in roles(b2.messages)

criteria.action: set options.num_predict to the requested MaxTokens when it is positive and not above m.MaxOutputTokens, otherwise to m.MaxOutputTokens when that is positive, otherwise to the requested value when it is positive, and otherwise omit num_predict
criteria.contract: e.g. requested 1000 with cap 32768 sends 1000; requested 50000 with cap 32768 sends 32768; no request and no cap sends no num_predict key

check.pseudocode: for (req,cap,want) in table: b=record(); assert b.options.get('num_predict')==want

criteria.action: send options.temperature, options.top_p and options.stop only when the request sets them, sending an explicit temperature of 0, and never send keep_alive, format or images
criteria.contract: a request with Temperature 0 records "temperature":0; a request without sampling fields records none of those keys; no recorded body carries keep_alive, format or images

setup: one request with Temperature 0, TopP 0.9 and StopSequences ["X"]
one request with none of them
check.pseudocode: assert b1.options.temperature==0 && 'temperature' in b1.options; assert 'temperature' not in b2.options; assert none(k in b for k in ['keep_alive','format','images'])

requirements.title: Tools and tool choice
requirements.rationale: Ollama's tool type carries only a subset of JSON Schema and has no tool-choice field.

criteria.action: declare each core.ToolWire, in request order, as a function tool with its name, its description and the tool-schema subset obtained by JSON-encoding its InputSchema and decoding it into the SDK's tool-parameter type
criteria.contract: a schema with additionalProperties, format and minimum records a tool whose parameters keep type, properties, required, enum, items and descriptions but none of those three keywords

setup: two tools; the first schema has additionalProperties:false, a string property with format "uri", an integer with minimum 1, an enum, an array with items, descriptions and required
check.pseudocode: p=b.tools[0].function.parameters; assert p.required==[...]; assert !contains(json(p),'additionalProperties'|'format'|'minimum')

criteria.condition: a core.ToolWire has a nil InputSchema
criteria.action: declare the tool with an empty object schema
criteria.contract: recorded parameters equal {"type":"object","properties":{}}

setup: a ToolWire with InputSchema nil
check.pseudocode: assert json_equal(b.tools[0].function.parameters, {type:'object',properties:{}})

criteria.condition: a tool's schema cannot be decoded into the SDK's tool-parameter type
criteria.action: fail the turn before any HTTP request is sent
criteria.contract: the stream ends with a non-nil Err whose text starts with "ollama:" and names the tool; the recording server sees zero requests

setup: a tool "bad_tool" whose schema encodes to JSON the SDK parameter type rejects (e.g. a property type of an incompatible JSON shape)
a recording server
check.pseudocode: res = drain(c.Stream(ctx, req)); assert res.Err != nil; assert hasPrefix(res.Err.Error(),'ollama:') && contains(...,'bad_tool'); assert srv.count==0

criteria.condition: Request.ToolChoice is core.ToolChoiceNone
criteria.action: send no tools key at all, while ToolChoiceUnset and ToolChoiceAuto send the declared tools
criteria.contract: the recorded body has no "tools" key under ToolChoiceNone

setup: a request with one tool
check.pseudocode: assert 'tools' not in bodyNone; assert len(bodyUnset.tools)==1 && len(bodyAuto.tools)==1

requirements.title: Transcript replay
requirements.rationale: The second turn of a tool loop must pair results to calls by id and keep the arguments the server sent.

criteria.action: pass Request.Messages through provider.RepairToolPairing before encoding, never mutate the caller's slice, and send the repair report to Options.Warnf when the repair changed anything (discarding it when Warnf is nil)
criteria.contract: Warnf is called exactly once when the repair changed the transcript and not at all otherwise; the input messages are deeply equal before and after Stream

setup: a transcript with an assistant tool call that has no result
a clean transcript
a Warnf spy
a deep copy of the first transcript
a second client with Warnf nil
check.pseudocode: drain(stream(broken)); assert warn.calls==1; assert reflect.DeepEqual(broken, copy); assert contains(body,'No result provided')

criteria.action: send a core.UserMessage as role user with its text as content, and a core.AssistantMessage as role assistant with its text as content and one tool_calls entry per ToolUseBlock carrying the block's id, its position among the message's calls as index, its name and arguments decoded from ToolUseBlock.Input
criteria.contract: recorded assistant message carries tool_calls[i].id equal to the block ID and function.index equal to i

setup: a transcript: user text; assistant with text and two ToolUseBlocks (ids call_a, call_b); a successful result for call_a; an error result for call_b
check.pseudocode: a=b.messages[1]; assert a.tool_calls[1].id=='call_b' && a.tool_calls[1].function.index==1; t=b.messages[3]; assert t.role=='tool' && t.tool_call_id=='call_b' && startsWith(t.content,'Error: ')

criteria.action: for any JSON object in ToolUseBlock.Input, replay its arguments with their keys in the order of those bytes
criteria.contract: the recorded arguments' key order equals the key order of Input

setup: an assistant message whose single ToolUseBlock has generated Input
check.pseudocode: for obj in gen_ordered_objects(): body = record(withInput(obj.bytes)); assert keyOrder(rawArguments(body)) == obj.keys

criteria.action: set the assistant message's thinking to the concatenated text of its non-redacted thinking blocks only when the message's Model equals m.ID, and drop all other thinking without sending it as content
criteria.contract: thinking from another model or a redacted block appears nowhere in the recorded body

setup: an assistant message with Model == m.ID carrying a thinking block "mine1", a redacted block "redacted-secret" and another thinking block "mine2"
an assistant message with Model "other-model" carrying thinking "foreign-thought"
check.pseudocode: assert b.messages[1].thinking=='mine1mine2'; assert !contains(raw,'redacted-secret') && !contains(raw,'foreign-thought')

criteria.action: send each core.ToolResultMessage, in transcript order, as one tool message whose content is provider.ToolResultText of the result, with the tool's name and the tool-call id it answers
criteria.contract: recorded tool message carries role "tool", tool_name, tool_call_id and content prefixed "Error: " when IsError is true

requirements.title: Effort as think
requirements.rationale: The catalog row decides which think levels a model accepts, read the same way provider/anthropic reads it, with no clamping.

criteria.condition: the request's effort is empty or m.ThinkingKind is core.ThinkingKindNone
criteria.action: send no think field
criteria.contract: the recorded body has no "think" key

setup: a request with empty effort on a model with efforts
a request with effort high on a model whose ThinkingKind is none
check.pseudocode: assert 'think' not in b1 && 'think' not in b2

criteria.condition: the request carries a non-empty effort and m.Efforts is nil
criteria.action: send think as the effort's own name as a string level
criteria.contract: effort high on an unlisted model records "think":"high"

setup: an unlisted model with Efforts nil
check.pseudocode: assert b.think == 'high'

criteria.condition: the request carries a non-empty effort and m.Efforts is non-nil
criteria.action: send no think when the effort is absent from the map or maps to nil, and otherwise send the mapped value trimmed and lower-cased as a string level, never substituting another level
criteria.contract: xhigh on the qwen3.8:27b row records no "think"; medium records "think":"medium"

setup: the qwen3.8:27b row from catalog.Select("ollama","STANDARD","")
a custom map {medium: " Medium ", low: nil}
check.pseudocode: assert 'think' not in rec('xhigh'); assert rec('medium').think=='medium'

requirements.title: Streaming decode
requirements.rationale: The loop consumes canonical events and a final message regardless of vendor.

criteria.condition: the first chunk of a response arrives
criteria.action: push MessageStartEvent with a partial message whose Model is m.ID, whose Effort is the request's effort and whose Timestamp comes from Options.Now
criteria.contract: the first event is core.MessageStartEvent with those three fields set

setup: Options.Now returning a fixed time T
request effort medium
check.pseudocode: e := events[0].(core.MessageStartEvent); assert e.Message.Model==m.ID && e.Message.Effort=='medium' && e.Message.Timestamp==T

criteria.condition: a chunk carries non-empty message.thinking or message.content
criteria.action: stream thinking as ThinkingStartEvent and ThinkingDeltaEvent and content as TextStartEvent and TextDeltaEvent, close the open block when the kind switches, append each completed block to the partial message followed by a MessageUpdateEvent, and never report thinking as text
criteria.contract: the final message holds a ThinkingBlock and a TextBlock in streamed order; no TextDeltaEvent carries thinking text

setup: a server streaming thinking "ponder" in two chunks, then content "answer" in two chunks, then a done chunk
check.pseudocode: assert kinds(final.Content)==['thinking','text']; assert all(!contains(d.Delta,'ponder') for d in textDeltas)

criteria.condition: a chunk carries tool calls
criteria.action: turn each call into one ToolUseBlock built through core.NewToolUse that keeps the vendor's id and whose Input is the arguments' JSON with keys in wire order (absent arguments become {}), pushing ToolCallStartEvent then one ToolInputDeltaEvent carrying the whole argument JSON before appending the block
criteria.contract: the final message's ToolUseBlock.ID equals the wire id and Input preserves the server's key order

setup: a server chunk with a tool call id "call_9", name "lookup" and arguments {"zeta":1,"alpha":2,"mid":3}
a second call with no arguments
check.pseudocode: assert final.tool[0].ID=='call_9'; assert keyOrder(final.tool[0].Input)==['zeta','alpha','mid']; assert final.tool[1].Input=='{}'

criteria.action: for any set of tool calls without an id across one or more responses of one Client, synthesize ids that are unique within each response and across responses
criteria.contract: no two ToolUseBlock IDs produced by the same Client are equal

setup: one Client against a server that serves tool calls without ids
check.pseudocode: seen=set(); for resp in gen_responses(): for b in toolBlocks(stream(resp)): assert b.ID != '' and b.ID not in seen; seen.add(b.ID)

criteria.condition: the done chunk arrives
criteria.action: after processing its own content, push TextEndEvent, ThinkingEndEvent and ToolCallEndEvent in block order, build the final message with RawStopReason equal to done_reason verbatim, ResponseModel equal to the chunk's model and Usage per 28-REQ-8, push MessageEndEvent and end the stream
criteria.contract: the stream result's Message is the final message and Err is nil

setup: servers streaming: (a) text, tool call, done_reason "stop"; (b) text, tool call, done_reason "length"; (c) text only, done_reason "stop"; model "resp-model" in the done chunk
check.pseudocode: assert endOrder==blockOrder; assert (a).StopReason==ToolUse; assert (b).StopReason==Length; assert (a).RawStopReason=='stop'

criteria.action: set StopReason to StopReasonLength when done_reason is length (even with tool calls), otherwise to StopReasonToolUse when the message has tool calls, otherwise to StopReasonStop
criteria.contract: done_reason "stop" with a tool call yields core.StopReasonToolUse

criteria.condition: several goroutines call Stream on the same *Client concurrently
criteria.action: complete every stream independently with no data race
criteria.contract: each stream yields its own final message; go test -race reports no race

setup: one Client
a server echoing a per-request marker into its response text
go test -race
check.pseudocode: parallel(32, i -> assert text(drain(c.Stream(ctx, reqWith(i)))) == marker(i))

requirements.title: Incomplete turns and errors
requirements.rationale: A local server's failures are not transient, so each one is named once, without retries, and a partial turn can never run a tool.

criteria.condition: Stream is called with a context that is already done
criteria.action: return the context's error without sending a request, and carry every later failure inside the stream as the failed message followed by Err on the last item
criteria.contract: (nil channel, ctx.Err()); the recording server sees zero requests

setup: a cancelled context
a recording server
check.pseudocode: ch, err := c.Stream(cancelledCtx, req); assert ch==nil && err==context.Canceled; assert srv.count==0

criteria.condition: the stream ends, or the SDK Chat call returns, without a done chunk
criteria.action: end the turn with StopReasonError and a terminal ErrorEvent, keeping the text and thinking that streamed and dropping every tool call
criteria.contract: Err wraps ollama.ErrStreamTruncated; the message has no ToolUseBlock

setup: a server that streams text "partial" and a tool call, then closes the body without done:true
check.pseudocode: assert errors.Is(res.Err, ErrStreamTruncated); assert msg.StopReason==Error; assert noToolUse(msg); assert lastError.Terminal

criteria.condition: the caller's context is cancelled while a request is in flight
criteria.action: stop the request within 1 second and end the turn with StopReasonAborted and ErrorMessage "Request was aborted", pushing no ErrorEvent and keeping no tool call, taking precedence over every other error classification
criteria.contract: Err is core.ErrAborted; the message has no ToolUseBlock

setup: a server that sends a text chunk and a tool call chunk, then blocks
check.pseudocode: cancel(); res = waitWithin(1s); assert res.Err==core.ErrAborted; assert msg.ErrorMessage=='Request was aborted'; assert noErrorEvent && noToolUse(msg)

criteria.condition: connecting to the host fails (refused, DNS failure or no route)
criteria.action: end the turn with an error naming the host, suggesting ollama serve and naming OLLAMA_HOST
criteria.contract: Err wraps ollama.ErrUnreachable; text starts with "ollama:"

setup: a provider whose Host is a loopback port that was listened on and closed
check.pseudocode: assert errors.Is(res.Err, ErrUnreachable); assert contains(txt,host) && contains(txt,'ollama serve') && contains(txt,'OLLAMA_HOST')

criteria.condition: the server answers 404
criteria.action: end the turn with an error naming the model and the host, including Ollama's message and suggesting ollama pull <model>
criteria.contract: Err wraps ollama.ErrModelNotFound and errors.As yields *ollama.StatusError with Code 404

setup: a server answering 404 with {"error":"model 'qwen3.8:27b' not found"}
check.pseudocode: var se *StatusError; assert errors.Is(err, ErrModelNotFound) && errors.As(err,&se) && se.Code==404; assert contains(txt,'ollama pull '+m.ID)

criteria.condition: Ollama's error message, in a status error or an error line inside a 200 stream, says the input exceeds the context length
criteria.action: end the turn with an error naming the model and the num_ctx sent, including Ollama's message and saying that a model already loaded at a smaller length keeps it until it unloads
criteria.contract: Err wraps ollama.ErrContextWindow

setup: a server answering 400 with {"error":"the input length exceeds the context length"}
another server answering 200 with an error line of the same message in the stream
check.pseudocode: for srv in [status400, inStream]: assert errors.Is(err, ErrContextWindow); assert contains(txt,'32768') && contains(txt,m.ID) && contains(txt,'unloads')

criteria.condition: the server answers any other non-2xx status or sends any other error line inside a 200 stream
criteria.action: end the turn with StopReasonError and a terminal ErrorEvent; for 401 or 403 the text names the host, says AgentKit sends no credential to Ollama and says to check OLLAMA_HOST; for other statuses the text is "ollama: HTTP <code>: <Ollama's message>"; an in-stream error carries Ollama's message classified by the rules of 28-REQ-7.4 to 28-REQ-7.6
criteria.contract: Err is a *ollama.StatusError{Code, Text} for a status error; a non-nil error starting with "ollama:" for an in-stream error

setup: servers answering 401, 403, 500 {"error":"boom"}, and 200 with an in-stream error line {"error":"model runner crashed"}
check.pseudocode: assert se.Code==401 && contains(txt,'no credential') && contains(txt,'OLLAMA_HOST'); assert txt500=='ollama: HTTP 500: boom'

criteria.action: make exactly one HTTP attempt per Stream call, and start every error text with "ollama:" while never including the value of any environment variable other than OLLAMA_HOST in an error, event or warning
criteria.contract: the recording server counts exactly one request per Stream call for every failure status

setup: servers answering 404, 401, 429, 500, 503 and a closed port
distinctive values set for ANTHROPIC_API_KEY, OPENROUTER_API_KEY and OLLAMA_API_KEY
a Warnf spy
check.pseudocode: for st in statuses: drain(stream()); assert srv.count==1; assert hasPrefix(err,'ollama:'); assert !containsAny(allText, secrets)

requirements.title: Usage and zero cost
requirements.rationale: Ollama runs on the embedder's hardware, so a run is priced at zero rather than flagged unpriced.

criteria.condition: the done chunk reports usage
criteria.action: set InputTokens to prompt_eval_count minus prompt_eval_cached_count floored at 0, CacheReadTokens to the cached count only when it is positive, OutputTokens to eval_count, Requests to 1 and the cost to 0 with its presence bit, leaving reasoning tokens unset, for listed and unlisted model ids alike
criteria.contract: 354/256/120 yields core.Usage{InputTokens: 98, CacheReadTokens: 256, OutputTokens: 120, Requests: 1, CostUSD: 0} with Has(core.UsageCostUSD) true

setup: a done chunk with prompt_eval_count 354, prompt_eval_cached_count 256, eval_count 120
once with a listed model id and once with an unlisted one
check.pseudocode: u := final.Usage; assert u.InputTokens==98 && u.CacheReadTokens==256 && u.OutputTokens==120 && u.Requests==1; assert u.Has(UsageCostUSD) && u.CostUSD==0

criteria.action: for any non-negative prompt, cached and eval counts, report InputTokens = max(0, prompt - cached), report OutputTokens = eval and report CacheReadTokens only when cached > 0
criteria.contract: InputTokens is never negative

setup: done chunks with generated counts
check.pseudocode: for p,c,e in gen(): u=usageOf(done(p,c,e)); assert u.InputTokens==max(0,p-c) && u.OutputTokens==e; assert u.Has(CacheRead)==(c>0)

criteria.condition: a turn fails before its done chunk
criteria.action: report Requests 1 and no token fields
criteria.contract: the failed message's Usage has Requests 1 and no input, output or cache-read presence bits

setup: a server that answers 500
a server that truncates the stream
check.pseudocode: u := msg.Usage; assert u.Requests==1 && !u.Has(Input) && !u.Has(Output) && !u.Has(CacheRead)

requirements.title: Dependency pin and policy
requirements.rationale: A new third-party module enters the root module only as a deliberate, pinned and approved change that leaves every existing test meaning the same.

criteria.action: require github.com/ollama/ollama as a direct, non-indirect requirement of the root module at exactly v0.40.7, listed in approvedDeps with a reason comment and in preSpec13Direct
criteria.contract: a pin test in internal/policy/deps_test.go passes and fails for any other version or an // indirect marker

setup: the root go.mod
approvedDeps and preSpec13Direct in internal/policy/deps_test.go
check.pseudocode: r = requireLine('github.com/ollama/ollama'); assert r.version=='v0.40.7' && !r.indirect; assert approvedDeps has it; assert preSpec13Direct has it

criteria.action: compare the root and sandbox module graphs to regenerated snapshots (go-list-m-all.txt, sandbox-go-list-m-all.txt and sandbox-go-list-m-all.14.txt), recording every version raised by minimum version selection as an accepted upgrade in a map distinct from d1Upgrades and deleting no test
criteria.contract: TS-13-65, TS-14-42, TS-15-40 and TS-17-60 pass with the restated expectations

setup: regenerated testdata/go-list-m-all.txt, sandbox-go-list-m-all.txt and sandbox-go-list-m-all.14.txt
an accepted-upgrades map distinct from d1Upgrades
the existing tests TS-13-65, TS-14-42, TS-15-40 and TS-17-60 still present
check.pseudocode: run go test ./internal/policy -run 'TS13_65|TS14_42|TS15_40|TS17_60'; assert exit 0; assert test funcs still exist

criteria.action: expect the provider directories anthropic, faux, ollama and openrouter in TestProviderDefaults_TS09_11
criteria.contract: the test asserts "anthropic,faux,ollama,openrouter"

setup: the provider directory listing in the repository
check.pseudocode: assert join(readDirNames('provider'),',') == 'anthropic,faux,ollama,openrouter'

criteria.action: keep every existing provider/anthropic and provider/faux test passing without modification and keep make check passing
criteria.contract: make check exits 0

setup: no edits to provider/anthropic or provider/faux test files
check.pseudocode: run make check; assert exit==0; assert git diff provider/anthropic provider/faux '*_test.go' is empty

execution_paths.title: An agent completes a two-turn tool loop on a recording Ollama server

steps.action: builds the provider with ollama.New(catalog.Select("ollama", "STANDARD", "") row, Options{Env: {"OLLAMA_HOST": <recording server>}}) and passes it as agentkit.Config.Provider with one tool
calls Stream with the system prompt, the user message, the tool and effort medium
encodes model qwen3.8:27b, num_ctx 32768, truncate false, think medium, stream true and the tool-schema subset, and sends one /api/chat request with no Authorization header
streams thinking, a tool call with an id and ordered arguments, and a done chunk with done_reason stop
